computing_programs.detailed_criteria: At least 50% marks in Intermediate (HSSC) examination with Mathematics or equivalent qualification with Mathematics, certified by IBCC. OR At least 50% marks in Intermediate (HSSC) examination with Pre-Medical or equivalent qualification, certified by IBCC. Students who have appeared/passed Intermediate with Pre-Med subjects are eligible subject to the students clearing the specified Mathematics courses within two semesters of starting the BS Studies at CUI.
computing_programs.entry_test_requirement: Valid NTS test score as per CUI policy.

engineering_programs.detailed_criteria: Intermediate (HS/HSSC/A-level) Pre-Engineering with Physics, Mathematics and Chemistry with minimum 60% marks or DAE in the same/relevant field with minimum 60% marks or Intermediate with ICS (Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science/Computer Studies) with minimum 60% marks.
engineering_programs.deficiency_policy: Students passed Intermediate with ICS will have to study Chemistry as remedial course in 1st semester.
engineering_programs.entry_test_requirement: Valid Entry Test score (minimum 33%) by NTS or by any PEC designated Testing HEIs/entities.
engineering_programs.general_note: All other term(s) and condition(s) regarding undergraduate program(s) approved by the Competent Authority and/or approved by the Pakistan Engineering Council, if any, amended from time to time shall be applicable.

other_programs.detailed_criteria: Intermediate or equivalent with minimum 50% marks from an accredited institution.
other_programs.entry_test_requirement: Valid NTS test score as per CUI policy.

result_awaiting_policy.fsc_students: F.Sc Part-2 result-awaiting candidates can apply on the basis of F.Sc Part-1 results, provided they have no 'F' (failed) grade in any course. Provisional admission will be cancelled immediately if they fail to secure the minimum required percentage in the final complete result.
result_awaiting_policy.a_level_students: A-Level result-awaiting candidates must apply on the basis of their O-Level equivalence certificate issued by IBCC. Merit will be formulated using the O-Level equivalence score and entrance exam marks.
result_awaiting_policy.supplementary_policy: Students with a supplementary ('supply') in F.Sc Part-1 cannot apply. They are eligible to apply in subsequent admission sessions once they have fully passed F.Sc.

NAT-IE.title: Pre-Engineering
NAT-IE.description: Applicable for admission in BS Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, and Artificial Intelligence.
NAT-IE.test_distribution: English: 20%, Analytical: 20%, Quantitative: 20%, Physics: 10%, Chemistry: 10%, Mathematics: 10% (Total: 90 MCQs)

NAT-IM.title: Pre-Medical
NAT-IM.description: Applicable for admission in BS Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence (with remedial Math course), Business Administration, Accounting & Finance, and Psychology.
NAT-IM.test_distribution: English: 20%, Analytical: 20%, Quantitative: 20%, Physics: 10%, Chemistry: 10%, Biology: 10% (Total: 90 MCQs)

NAT-ICS.title: Computer Science
NAT-ICS.description: Applicable for admission in BS Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Engineering, Civil/Electrical/Mechanical Engineering (ICS Physics, Math, Computer group with remedial Chemistry), Business Administration, Accounting & Finance, and Psychology.
NAT-ICS.test_distribution: English: 20%, Analytical: 20%, Quantitative: 20%, Physics: 10%, Computer Science: 10%, Mathematics: 10% (Total: 90 MCQs)

NAT-ICOM.title: Commerce
NAT-ICOM.description: Applicable for admission in BS Business Administration, Accounting & Finance, and Psychology.
NAT-ICOM.test_distribution: English: 20%, Analytical: 20%, Quantitative: 20%, Accounting: 10%, Commerce: 10%, Economics: 10% (Total: 90 MCQs)

NAT-IA.title: Arts & Humanities
NAT-IA.description: Applicable for admission in BS Psychology, BS Business Administration, and Accounting & Finance.
NAT-IA.test_distribution: English: 20%, Analytical: 20%, Quantitative: 20%, Islamiyat: 10%, Pakistan Studies: 10%, General Knowledge: 10% (Total: 90 MCQs)

NAT-IGS.title: General Science
NAT-IGS.description: Applicable for admission in BS Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Business Administration, Accounting & Finance, and Psychology.
NAT-IGS.test_distribution: English: 20%, Analytical: 20%, Quantitative: 20%, Mathematics: 10%, Economics: 10%, Statistics: 10% (Total: 90 MCQs)

graduate_ms.degree_requirement: 16-year relevant degree from an accredited institution.
graduate_ms.division_rule: There shall be no 3rd Division throughout the academic career.
graduate_ms.work_experience: Work experience is not considered in the calculation of the aggregate merit list.
graduate_ms.detailed_criteria: A minimum CGPA 2.5 out of 4.0 (in the semester system) or 55% marks (in the annual system) in a sixteen-year degree program in the same or relevant field from an HEC-recognized university/HEI is required.
graduate_ms.entry_test_requirement: NTS/HAT, General/Subject/Equivalent tests conducted by testing bodies accredited by HEC, with a passing score of 50% marks. In addition, CUI may also conduct/accept subject tests provided the test is not conducted by GRE/NTS/HAT for admission to Master of Science (MS) program with a passing score of 60%, if deemed necessary.
graduate_ms.interdisciplinary_policy: Interdisciplinary admission(s) may be considered as per notification.

GAT-A.title: Business & Engineering
GAT-A.description: Required for MS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Management Sciences, and Project Management.

GAT-B.title: Arts, Humanities & Social Sciences
GAT-B.description: Required for MS in Psychology and English Linguistics.

GAT-C.title: Biological, Physical & Computer Sciences
GAT-C.description: Required for MS in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, and Artificial Intelligence Engineering.

GAT-D.title: Religious Studies
GAT-D.description: Required for candidates with a Madrassa background (Shadat-Ul-Aalmiya) and HEC equivalence seeking MS/M.Phil.

graduate_phd.degree_requirement: Respective MS/MPhil program with thesis (non-thesis MS degree holders cannot apply).
graduate_phd.division_rule: There shall be no 3rd Division throughout the academic career.
graduate_phd.detailed_criteria: A minimum CGPA of 3.00 out of 4.0 (in the semester system) or 60% marks/1st Division (in the annual system) in an eighteen-year degree program in the same or relevant field from an HEC-recognized university/HEI is required.
graduate_phd.entry_test_requirement: NTS GAT (Subject) or GRE Subject test with a minimum passing score of 60%. If no NTS/GRE subject test exists for a particular discipline, CUI may conduct its own subject test with a passing score of 70%.

gat_subject_test.purpose: Mandatory for PhD admission at CUI Wah Campus. Evaluates field-specific academic knowledge.
gat_subject_test.score_distribution: General Section: 30% (English/Verbal: 15%, Analytical Reasoning: 15%) | Subject Section: 70% (discipline-specific)
gat_subject_test.passing_score_nts_gre: Minimum 60% marks required (NTS GAT Subject or GRE Subject).
gat_subject_test.passing_score_cui_test: If NTS/GRE Subject test is not available for a discipline, CUI conducts its own test. Passing score: 70%.
gat_subject_test.validity: 2 years from the date of the test.
gat_subject_test.gre_equivalence: GRE Subject Test is accepted as an alternative to NTS GAT Subject for PhD admission.
gat_subject_test.interview_requirement: Candidates who qualify the GAT Subject test are then called for a departmental interview/test. Admission is offered only after passing the departmental interview.

equivalence_requirements.o_level_a_level: Equivalence certificates for both O-Level (10th grade) and A-Level (12th grade) must be obtained separately from the Inter Board Chairman Committee (IBCC). A combined equivalency is not acceptable.
equivalence_requirements.foreign_qualifications: American High School, GED, and other foreign qualifications must obtain equivalent certificates for 10th and 12th grades separately from IBCC before applying. Otherwise, the form will be rejected.
